speaker: Doctor
text:
The clinical picture of a 33-week premature infant with early-onset respiratory distress, grunting, and retractions is highly suggestive of Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome. To confirm this diagnosis and rule out other causes like pneumonia or pneumothorax, I need to visualize the lung fields.

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Fine reticular granulation with ground glass appearance on both lungs

speaker: Doctor
text:
The chest X-ray findings of fine reticular granulation with a ground-glass appearance are classic for Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS) in a preterm infant. This confirms the diagnosis of surfactant deficiency.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome
